patch.value: Refresh ADO and Jev catalog metadata after upstream manifest changes

Read-only comparison with the canonical fleet found that pm-ado now describes SDK import/export/sync and three-way reconciliation; pm-jev now includes the jev link command. The catalog and committed snapshot still carry the previous descriptions. Refresh metadata and commands together with regression evidence in a separate change.
Catalog metadata and snapshot match the intended ADO and Jev manifests; live-fleet freshness and standalone release checks pass.
